reuse.why: Correctly threads the flag through the existing shared ensureAccountIsNotLinked guard used by all six providers, but re-writes unlinkAccount's account-reset update instead of extracting and sharing it.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, sync status) is copied verbatim from unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts.

placement.why: Putting the takeover in the link module is reasonable, but a guard named ensure...IsNotLinked now silently mutates another account, hiding a side effect inside a check.

scope.why: Only the flag plumbing through the six link handlers, the guard and a focused test.

maintainability.why: Two copies of what 'unlinked' means will drift, and the mutating guard (run before the bank is found or the new account created) is surprising to future readers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: link.ts ensureAccountIsNotLinked resets the old account with its own db.updateAccount instead of a shared unlink-state helper extracted from unlinkAccount in accounts/app.ts
